summary.intent: Resolve all 6 open PR review comments from automated reviewers (GitHub Copilot, CodeRabbit) on the cipher-box repository's current PR.
summary.outcome: All 6 review threads were triaged and fixed — missing checkout ref, unpinned npm deps, wrong script filenames in validation doc, SHA drift across jobs, and a shell injection vulnerability. Fixes were committed and pushed after passing type checks.

repo: cipher-box uses GitHub Actions workflows for tag-staging, pr-release-preview, and post-merge-release pipelines
Validation docs live under .planning/phases/<phase-id>/<phase-id>-VALIDATION.md and reference specific script filenames
Scripts referenced in 41-VALIDATION.md had .mjs extensions that should be .js

code.finding: SHA drift risk: multiple jobs each resolving their own SHA for main independently; fixed by adding a resolve-main job and sharing its output
Shell injection vulnerability via unquoted `inputs.description` interpolated directly into run step; required env var indirection fix
npm install without --frozen-lockfile or lockfile pinning — unpinned deps risk
Same unpinned npm deps issue as pr-release-preview.yml
Script filenames listed with .mjs extension but actual scripts use .js extension

workflow: GraphQL reviewThreads API is the correct way to fetch unresolved PR threads; REST API does not expose resolution status
Replying to review comments requires REST (`gh api repos/.../pulls/.../comments --field in_reply_to=<int>`) while resolving requires GraphQL mutation
Large tool results from GraphQL may require multiple reads when truncated

friction: GraphQL response for review threads was large enough to require multiple Read tool calls to parse fully
User interrupted mid-flow suspecting 529 rate-limit errors, though none were occurring — large result size mimicked the symptom
open_items: Review threads were fixed and committed but the transcript ends before confirming threads were individually replied to and resolved via the API
E2E tests were not run — only typecheck was confirmed; PR changes touched CI workflows which may warrant manual workflow validation
